summary.text: Mike Brady is a Democratic state senator who has represented the 2nd Plymouth and Norfolk District since 2015 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2009 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Michael Brady graduated from Brockton High School in 1980.
He has served on the Brockton City Council and the Brockton School Committee.
He represented the 9th Plymouth District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2009 to 2015 before taking his Senate seat.

In the 2025-2026 session, Brady chairs the Public Service Joint Committee, is vice chair of the Community Development and Small Businesses and the Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy joint committees, and sits on the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
